title: Urology and Continence Supply Program enrollment and tier assignment standard
content:
A Urology and Continence Supply Program is opened when Larkfield accepts a referral for this product line. The tier written on the program is fixed by the coverage the program bills, never by the customer's preference.

## 1. Locating the tier

1.1 The tier is located from the coverage record named on the program. The coverage record's plan type and coverage order must equal the tier's entry gate. The self-pay tier is used only when no coverage record is named.

1.2 Entry gates of the six tiers:

| Tier | Coverage record named | Coverage order | Product lines | Clinical qualification read from the program's documentation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Continence Self-Pay Program | none (a written order is required) | not applicable | intermittent, external and indwelling catheters; absorbent products | none |
| Continence Commercial HMO Program | commercial HMO plan; a network referral is required | primary | intermittent, external and indwelling catheters | permanent urinary retention or incontinence documented |
| Continence Commercial PPO Program | commercial PPO plan | primary | intermittent, external and indwelling catheters | permanent urinary retention or incontinence documented |
| Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Medicare Advantage plan | primary | intermittent, external and indwelling catheters | permanent urinary retention or incontinence documented |
| Continence Original Medicare Program | Original Medicare Part B | primary | intermittent, external and indwelling catheters | permanent urinary retention or incontinence documented |
| Continence Medicaid Program | Medicaid | primary | intermittent, external and indwelling catheters; absorbent products | permanent urinary retention or incontinence documented; for absorbent products, an incontinence assessment |

1.3 A customer with an in-effect Original Medicare Part B coverage record cannot be enrolled on the self-pay tier for an item Medicare covers. Larkfield submits a claim for every Medicare-covered item it supplies to a Medicare beneficiary, so that customer is enrolled on the Original Medicare tier. An item or quantity Medicare will not pay is handled under the liability notice rule.

1.4 When a customer has two in-effect coverage records, the one whose coverage order is primary fixes the tier. The secondary coverage only receives crossover or secondary claims. A coverage record whose coverage order is secondary never fixes the tier.

1.5 Any clinical qualification in the tier's entry gate is read from the program's own clinical fields, as documented on the prescriber's written order and medical records. It is never read from the customer's description alone.

## 2. Coverage in effect on the date of the write

The coverage record named on the program must be in effect on the date of the write. Its effective date is on or before that date, and its termination date is empty or on or after that date. This applies to opening a program and to every program change. It is judged from the coverage record on file, never from the customer's account of their insurance.

| Effective date | Termination date | In effect on the date of the write? |
|---|---|---|
| on or before the date | empty | yes |
| on or before the date | on the date itself, or later | yes |
| on or before the date | earlier than the date | no |
| after the date | any | no |

## 3. Program changes

3.1 When the customer's insurance changes, a program change rewrites the coverage reference and the tier together. When a newer written order changes prescriber or product fields, a program change rewrites those fields. A change never rewrites the program's status.

3.2 After a tier change, the next refill may draw only on an authorization grant recorded under the new tier.

3.3 A coverage the customer reports that is not on file cannot be written onto a program. Coverage records are created only by Larkfield's benefits verification team after the payer confirms eligibility.

## Points of judgement

- *A customer holds a primary commercial PPO coverage and a secondary Medicaid coverage, both in effect.* The primary PPO record fixes the tier, so the program is on the Continence Commercial PPO Program. The Medicaid record only receives crossover or secondary claims.
- *A customer reports a new plan by phone that Larkfield has no coverage record for.* That coverage cannot be written onto the program.
- *Hypothetical dates:* a coverage record with a termination date of the 30th is in effect for a write made on the 30th. It is no longer in effect for a write made on the 31st.
